scope: Exactly nine assigned consumer SKILL.md files; all visited, no unchanged files. No baselines copied; baseline bytes are Git3c148dc6.
method: Read complete assigned files and scan their lines; inspect changed prose contexts, remove local repetition/shorten wording only. Preserve structured interfaces exactly. This is a bounded mechanical/simple-prose pass, not a new full semantic/workflow qualification.
token_method: ceil(UTF-16 code units /4) per full file, summed; estimates, not billed usage

guard_inspection.method: Scan quoted literals of at least15 characters that occur in original assigned source; reject any edit losing such a literal. Inspect relevant source-guard phrase matches. Also compare complete ordered frontmatter/headings/bold spans/inline code/code fences before and after.
guard_inspection.limit: Literal search does not prove arbitrary regex compatibility. Root owns integration checks; no tests run.
